mapper.insert: INSERT INTO relic_pool(article_id, generation, pool_round, user_uuid, content, like_count, status, merge_deadline) VALUES(#{articleId}, #{generation}, #{poolRound}, #{userUuid}, #{content},0, 'pending', #{mergeDeadline})
INSERT IGNORE INTO relic_participants(article_id, generation, user_uuid) VALUES(#{articleId}, #{generation}, #{userUuid})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM relic_pool WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE relic_pool SET like_count = like_count +1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'pending'
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO relic_pool_likes(pool_id, user_uuid) VALUES(#{poolId}, #{userUuid})
mapper.update: UPDATE relic_pool SET status = 'discarded' WHERE article_id = #{articleId} AND generation = #{generation} AND pool_round = #{poolRound} AND status = 'pending' AND id != #{exceptId}
UPDATE relic_pool SET status = #{status}, merged_at = #{mergedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'pending'
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(seq),0) FROM relic_segments WHERE article_id = #{articleId} AND generation = #{generation}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO relic_segments(article_id, generation, seq, pool_round, user_uuid, content) VALUES(#{articleId}, #{generation}, #{seq}, #{poolRound}, #{userUuid}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE relic_segments SET content = #{content} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_uuid = #{userUuid}
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.article_id, s.generation, s.seq, s.pool_round, s.user_uuid, u.username, s.content, s.merged_at FROM relic_segments s LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.uuid = s.user_uuid AND u.is_deleted =0 WHERE s.article_id = #{articleId} AND s.generation = #{generation} ORDER BY s.seq ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM relic_segments WHERE article_id = #{articleId} AND generation = #{generation}

SELECT p.id, p.article_id, p.generation, p.pool_round, p.user_uuid, u.username, p.content, p.like_count, p.status, p.merge_deadline, p.create_time FROM relic_pool p LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.uuid = p.user_uuid AND u.is_deleted =0 WHERE p.article_id = #{articleId} AND p.generation = #{generation} AND p.pool_round = #{poolRound} AND p.status = 'pending' ORDER BY p.like_count DESC, p.create_time ASC
SELECT * FROM relic_pool WHERE status = 'pending' AND merge_deadline < NOW() ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO relic_destroy_votes(article_id, generation, user_uuid) VALUES(#{articleId}, #{generation}, #{userUuid})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM relic_destroy_votes WHERE article_id = #{articleId} AND generation = #{generation}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM relic_participants WHERE article_id = #{articleId} AND generation = #{generation}
SELECT user_uuid FROM relic_participants WHERE article_id = #{articleId} AND generation = #{generation}
mapper.update: UPDATE relic_pool SET status = 'destroyed' WHERE article_id = #{articleId} AND generation = #{generation} AND status = 'pending'
